worldcombat.skill.smartstrike.summary: The horn locks onto the target and steers itself in as it charges; it can only turn so far each tick, so a fast enough strafe slips around it. It stabs the seam of the armour: the higher the target's Defence, the deeper it bites.
worldcombat.skill.smartstrike.descriptio: The horn thrust deals about %1$s damage, biting deeper the higher the target's Defence. Defence, type matchup and crit are settled on the hit.

Locks a target within %1$s blocks, closes at %2$s blocks/tick, steering up to %3$s degrees per tick, with a %4$s block tip radius; the tip only turns so far each tick, so a steady strafe or a step around the side can shake it. It strikes whichever foe it reaches, once per cast. A wall or an ally in the way stops the tip at the contact surface instead of stabbing through; if the target leaves, it makes one short jab along the last heading.
The stab drives the target back %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.smartstrike.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.smartstrike.growth.0: At level %1$s: thrust power %2$s and steering %3$s degrees/tick.
worldcombat.skill.smartstrike.growth.1: At level %1$s: thrust power %2$s and lock range %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.smartstrike.use.1: Stab the armour seam of a high-Defence target
worldcombat.skill.smartstrike.preference: On: lock range about +18%% and steering +4 degrees/tick, so it tracks further and harder, but each thrust is about 12%% weaker with 4 ticks more windup and 6 ticks more cooldown. Off: a quick thrust with a shorter lock, but heavier and faster.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of locking. Larger values let it strike first from further.

On: targets with high Defence are preferred because the thrust feeds on it; targets without Defence stats fall back to health ratio. Off: order it like a plain thrust, useful for finishing weakened foes.
On: the user may leave its post to lock on; off: it only strikes from where it stands.
